links.comparator_used: No direct comparator; silent prospective performance in the display-off arm was judged against the model's earlier development, before COVID-19 and five years earlier
links.outcome: Model discrimination and calibration for ICU transfer during silent prospective running
links.effect: AUROC 0.725 to 0.737 in 5184 display-off visits with 311 deterioration events; models well-calibrated
links.quote: We conclude that predictive statistical models developed five years before study initiation had good model performance despite the passage of time and the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

links.comparator_used: Baseline event rate; no alternative alerting strategy such as a single-threshold alert was compared
links.outcome: Positive predictive value of a hypothetical alert requiring a sustained rise in score
links.effect: PPV more than 10-fold the event rate
links.quote: A hypothetical alerting strategy based on a rise in score and duration of the rise would have had good performance, with a positive predictive value more than 10-fold the event rate.

design_hint: prospective local validation and drift monitoring in silent mode
